**Saudi Arabia**,[[d]](#cite_note-18) officially the **Kingdom of Saudi Arabia** (**KSA**),[[e]](#cite_note-19) is a country in [West Asia](/wiki/West_Asia "West Asia"). Located in the centre of the [Middle East](/wiki/Middle_East "Middle East"), it covers the bulk of the [Arabian Peninsula](/wiki/Arabian_Peninsula "Arabian Peninsula") and has a land area of about 2,150,000 km2 (830,000 sq mi), making it the [fifth-largest country](/wiki/List_of_Asian_countries_by_area "List of Asian countries by area") in [Asia](/wiki/Asia "Asia"), the largest in the Middle East, and the [twelfth-largest](/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_area "List of countries and dependencies by area") in the world. It is bordered by the [Red Sea](/wiki/Red_Sea "Red Sea") to the west; [Jordan](/wiki/Jordan "Jordan"), [Iraq](/wiki/Iraq "Iraq"), and [Kuwait](/wiki/Kuwait "Kuwait") to the north; the [Persian Gulf](/wiki/Persian_Gulf "Persian Gulf"), [Bahrain](/wiki/Bahrain "Bahrain"), [Qatar](/wiki/Qatar "Qatar") and the [United Arab Emirates](/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates") to the east; [Oman](/wiki/Oman "Oman") to the southeast; and [Yemen](/wiki/Yemen "Yemen") to [the south](/wiki/Saudi_Arabia%E2%80%93Yemen_border "Saudi Arabia–Yemen border"). The [Gulf of Aqaba](/wiki/Gulf_of_Aqaba "Gulf of Aqaba") in the northwest separates Saudi Arabia from [Egypt](/wiki/Egypt "Egypt") and [Israel](/wiki/Israel "Israel").[[15]](#cite_note-20)[[16]](#cite_note-21) Saudi Arabia is the only country with a coastline along both the [Red Sea](/wiki/Red_Sea "Red Sea") and the [Arabian Gulf](/wiki/Arabian_Gulf "Arabian Gulf"), and most of its terrain consists of arid desert, lowland, steppe, and mountains. The capital and largest city is [Riyadh](/wiki/Riyadh "Riyadh"); other major cities include [Jeddah](/wiki/Jeddah "Jeddah") and the two holiest cities in [Islam](/wiki/Islam "Islam"), [Mecca](/wiki/Mecca "Mecca") and [Medina](/wiki/Medina "Medina"). With a population of almost 32.2 million, Saudi Arabia is the fourth most populous country in the [Arab world](/wiki/Arab_world "Arab world").

Main article: [December 2017 Southern California wildfires](/wiki/December_2017_Southern_California_wildfires "December 2017 Southern California wildfires")

Multiple wildfires ignited in December across [Los Angeles](/wiki/Los_Angeles_County "Los Angeles County"), [San Bernardino](/wiki/San_Bernardino_County "San Bernardino County"), [Ventura](/wiki/Ventura_County "Ventura County"), [San Diego](/wiki/San_Diego_County "San Diego County"), [Riverside](/wiki/Riverside_County "Riverside County"), [Santa Barbara](/wiki/Santa_Barbara_County "Santa Barbara County") Counties. The fires were exacerbated by unusually powerful and long-lasting [Santa Ana winds](/wiki/Santa_Ana_winds "Santa Ana winds")[[105]](#cite_note-106) as well as large amounts of dry vegetation grown, due to large amounts of precipitation earlier in the year. The fires burned over 307,900 acres (1,246 km2), and caused traffic disruptions, school closures, hazardous air quality conditions, and massive power outages. California Governor [Jerry Brown](/wiki/Jerry_Brown "Jerry Brown") declared a [state of emergency](/wiki/State_of_emergency "State of emergency") in Ventura and Los Angeles Counties,[[106]](#cite_note-107) and Los Angeles Mayor [Eric Garcetti](/wiki/Eric_Garcetti "Eric Garcetti") declared a state of emergency for the city.[[107]](#cite_note-108) The largest fire was the [Thomas Fire](/wiki/Thomas_Fire "Thomas Fire"), which grew to 281,893 acres, becoming California's largest modern wildfire at the time, since surpassed by the [Mendocino Complex](/wiki/Mendocino_Complex_Fire "Mendocino Complex Fire")'s Ranch Fire in 2018.[[108]](#cite_note-109)[[109]](#cite_note-110)[[110]](#cite_note-111)[[111]](#cite_note-112)[[112]](#cite_note-113)
